newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka's Bank of Ceylon to open branch in Nepal.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka's Bank of Ceylon to open branch in Nepal.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Bank of Ceylon will open its sixth overseas branch in Nepal next week, a bank spokesman said on Friday.
"On Monday we will open the first branch in Nepal, where a second branch is planned by early 1997," he told Reuters.
The branch in Siddarthanagar, near Lumbini, Buddha's birthplace in Nepal, is expected to benefit from the country's agriculture and tourism industries, he said.

Bank of Ceylon, Sri Lanka's largest commercial bank, has two branches in London and one each in Male, the Maldives; Karachi, Pakistan and Madras, India. It plans to open a branch in Moscow in the first quarter of 1997.
